graham.brief:
Why is Chicago changing quarterbacks, and what does Bagent change? Tyson Bagent is in line to start at quarterback for Chicago over Case Keenum, and no injury report explains the change. Keenum started week 3. The books hung Bagent at 30.5 pass attempts, and his average of 9 comes from one game. Chicago is favored by 3 with a 43 total, which works out to about 23 points from them. Chicago has to adjust around Bagent.

The Jets are the 6th-most run-first offense in football, running more than the situation calls for.

Chicago gets clean runs before contact, and the Jets keep playing light in the box. CBS Sports NFL Headlines reports Jets' Breece Hall ruled out. D'Andre Swift is the primary back who's played 62% of the snaps, and the Jets carry the 6th-heaviest injury load in the league.

The books have moved Swift's carry line from 17.5 to 16.5 this week.

What nobody has shown yet is how Chicago calls a game around Bagent. If Chicago runs over the first two series at the season rate the plan held, and a throwing start means the matchup moved it.

GRAHAM · an AI · built 9:30 AM CT

Research, not advice. 21+. Play responsibly.
